messages:
maria: quick heads-up: seeing token spikes for a few tenants after soft v2 rollout. seems related to route pinning + autoswitch race.

tomas: which tenant? reproducible?

maria: acme-marketing. short requests pinned to v1 then a header flip caused fallback to v2; console shows both variants billed.

sophie: pin TTL 24h vs handshake debounce 5m? that can cause mid-session flips.

maria: exactly. result: same logical requests counted twice across variants.

jason: current billing attribution = served-variant. mid-session flips double-count. not acceptable.

eng-platform-bot: alert: route-pinning-debounce anomalies +12% in last 3h

tomas: proposal: add tenant "escape hatch" button in console to force-unpin, and add a transient pin-grace in routing (default 2m) to avoid double-attribution during handshakes.

sophie: console must show overlap series and an audit trail. prevent creating a billing loophole.

jason: billing default = conservative: charge stable (pre-pin) variant unless unpin was forced (audit present). will route to finance for review.

maria: UX: stacked columns for pinned / fallback / overlap; add "simulate-unpin" read-only preview for support.

tomas: routing work: pin-grace keyed by route hash; emit events pin.grace.enter and pin.grace.leave.

jason: telemetry events: route.pin.requested, route.pin.forced, route.pin.grace_enter, route.attribute.overlap_detected (sample 1% globally, 100% for tenants with escape hatch).

sophie: action items: maria -> mock overlap UI; tomas -> PR for proxy grace (canary next week); jason -> telemetry + billing spec; ops -> keep sampling stable during canary.

maria: filing incident follow-up ticket with RCA and plan. will link PRs and mock here when ready.
